positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY: reproduce EXACTLY the same number of people as appear in the provided photo. Not one more, not one fewer. If the photo shows one person, the output must show that one person completely alone. If it shows nine, exactly those nine. Never invent, add, duplicate, or imagine any additional person. No business partner, no supplier, no second party, no shoulder or hand belonging to anyone outside the photo. The meeting room behind and beside them is completely empty of other people.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed — nothing covers anyone's eyes, nose or mouth. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: ignore the clothing worn in the provided photo and dress everyone in professional business attire — a well-fitted blazer over a light collared shirt, consistent across the group. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in a plain neutral professional tone to match, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing prescription glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the provided reference image is the Garudafood corporate logo — a blue eagle head facing right with a gold beak and a blue leaf sprig below it, beside the bold blue "Garudafood" wordmark. Reproduce it accurately, keeping the blue and gold colours and the eagle shape intact. It appears small and neat on the left chest of every blazer, roughly palm-sized, and again as a clean brand mark on the meeting room wall behind them.

SCENE: standing at the head of a polished meeting table in a premium modern corporate meeting room with large windows. On the table in front of them: a signed sourcing agreement folder, and a neat row of raw material sample jars — peanuts, cocoa beans, wheat flour and corn kernels. The person nearest the camera rests a hand on the agreement folder, confident and settled, as if a deal has just been closed.

FRAMING: photographed by a photographer standing in front of the group at natural standing eye level, straight-on, horizon level. Not a selfie, no arm reaching toward the lens, no wide-angle distortion. Waist-up to mid-thigh crop — legs, knees, feet and shoes are not visible. Everyone stands in a natural staggered arrangement with subtle depth — bodies angled at a relaxed three-quarter turn of about 20 degrees, faces turned directly to the lens. Not a stiff straight row. Nobody hidden, every face sharp and individually recognisable.

LIGHTING: warm directional late-afternoon window light raking across the room, glowing on the polished table surface, a clean soft key light on every face, and a warm rim light edging shoulders. Confident, premium, executive warmth.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 40mm, f/2.0. Everyone tack sharp with a clear depth separation — the meeting room and windows behind rendering into soft creamy bokeh, background practical lights blooming into gentle round highlights. Subtle atmospheric haze in the air catching the light, giving the room real depth. Fine natural film grain, slight highlight roll-off, gentle anamorphic-style falloff at the frame edges. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural shine and subtle imperfections, no plastic smoothing.

GRADE: rich cinematic colour grading with deep controlled contrast — lifted filmic blacks, warm highlights, clean natural skin tones held perfectly neutral against the environment's colour. Premium FMCG brand campaign quality, the polish of a national television commercial. High resolution.

DO NOT: add, duplicate or invent any person; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes or a full-body view; render any readable text, document wording or signage other than the Garudafood wordmark itself; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces.
video_positive_prompt: Slow, authoritative cinematic dolly in. The subjects stand poised in negotiation triumph. The front person taps a hand gently on the signed agreement folder, looks up at the camera with a firm, triumphant, yet humble smile and a decisive nod. Late afternoon window light shimmers across the glass jars and wood table, rich filmic blacks.
video_negative_prompt: distorted face, face morphing, extra limbs, chaotic camera movement, glitch, blurry, deformed hands, mouth talking unnaturally, bad anatomy, cartoon, plastic skin, dull flat lighting
